:::{.proof}
$$\ba
\tp{(\matr{P}\vecf{v})}\,(\matr{I} - \matr{P})\vecf{v}
&= \tp{\vecf{v}}\,\tp{\matr{P}}\,(\matr{I} - \matr{P})\vecf{v} \\
&= \tp{\vecf{v}}\,\matr{P}\,(\matr{I} - \matr{P})\vecf{v} \\
&= \tp{\vecf{v}}\,(\matr{P} - \matr{P}^2)\vecf{v} \\
&= \tp{\vecf{v}}\,(\matr{P} - \matr{P})\vecf{v} \\
&= \tp{\vecf{v}}\,\matr{0}\,\vecf{v} \\
&= 0
\ea$$

where the second line uses symmetry ($\tp{\matr{P}} = \matr{P}$)
and the fourth line uses idempotency ($\matr{P}^2 = \matr{P}$).
:::
